summary: Practise IFRS S1 and S2 reporting, portfolio ESG analysis, and PCAF emissions calculations. Explore the five-day course and review the outline.
lede: ESG reporting training helps investment analysts, portfolio managers, and sustainability professionals connect portfolio evidence to clear disclosures. Participants practise materiality mapping, ESG data checks, financed-emissions calculations using PCAF methods, and portfolio dashboard design, while documenting sources and assumptions. The course also covers IFRS S1 and S2 reporting, stewardship evidence, and conceptual AI-assisted screening through exercises based on defined examples.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course is designed for professionals who prepare, review, or use ESG information in investment decisions and portfolio reporting. It suits people who already work with investment, sustainability, or reporting data and want a more structured way to connect evidence, metrics, and disclosures.
modules: IFRS S1 and S2 Reporting Foundations
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Working familiarity with investment analysis, portfolio reporting, or sustainability data is recommended. You should be comfortable reviewing spreadsheet tables; no coding or programming is required. AI-assisted ESG screening and Power BI dashboard concepts receive introductory, conceptual treatment, while Excel exercises focus on operational application.
